output.summary: Perennial flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. Its leaves have distinctive curled edges above a large basal rosette, and it has a large yellow, forked taproot. Young leaves are eaten boiled in several changes of water or raw in moderation; mature plants are too bitter, while thoroughly dried seeds are also edible.
